LanguageData.DF_SpawnDescription_Neolithic: Wandering exiles, cast out from old tribes or lone wanderers, have united. Their strength lies in cohesion and knowledge of wild lands.
LanguageData.DF_SpawnDescription_Medieval: Survivors have formed a new commune with strict laws and walls of debris. They reject wasteland chaos and build order on their terms.
LanguageData.DF_SpawnDescription_Industrial: Ancient survivors awakened from cryosleep have decided to restore their former might. Their knowledge and technology challenge this savage world.
LanguageData.DF_SpawnDescription_Spacer: Space refugees whose ship crashed on the planet. They cling to remnants of civilization, using wreckage for survival and rebirth.
LanguageData.DF_SpawnDescription_Ultra: High-tech syndicate operating from the shadows, appearing out of nowhere. Their drones and mechs surpass all known technology, their goals hidden even from reconnaissance.
